fomod.Description:
An in-game hotkey palette that fires REAL keypresses, plus a full manager for followers, places, rooms, wardrobes, money, quests, spells and time. Two PrismaUI web views (F7 and F18), no ESP required for the core.
Requires SKSE64, Address Library for SKSE Plugins, and PrismaUI. Every other mod it works with is optional and detected at runtime — if it is not installed, the feature hides itself or says so on screen.
